# Source-owned interface bodies

These independently authored interfaces retain a generic default body, a static
body and a private instance body called from another default. A generic child
interface and input implementation inherit them without copying bodies. The
tracing class comes from `value_carrier_bridges`.

The oracle compares three values, 27 identities and six ordered failures. Its
authored JVM harness overrides the public default and declares a same-named
public method as the parent's private method, proving that private dispatch stays
bound to the original declaration. Full generic reflection is unchanged. All
generated private helpers are reported, and the recovered source requires Java
9. A generic Signature with mismatched runtime erasure is rejected.
